question.text: Per Section 3.3.1 of Chapter 3, as part of the PRE-LISTING process, the NPO shall provide audited financial statements for the previous ____ years and social impact statements.

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Section 3.3.1 states: 'As part of the pre-listing process, the NPO shall provide audited financial statements for the previous 3 years and social impact statements.' This 3-year window aligns with the Age-of-NPO minimum (3 years) and the 67%-of-3-year-average tests in Section 3.1.1(c). **The Trap:** 1 year is too short. 2 years is a common mis-recall. 5 years is used in other contexts (IT scrutiny) but not SSE pre-listing. The SIA must hold the 3-year anchor firm. **Cross-Exam Context:** III-A/III-C (Compliance) test 3-year financials for Main Board ICDR. XV (RA) uses 5-year audited FS for research. XII (SMF) tests prospectus disclosures. XXIII uses 3 years across age, revenue/expenditure test, and pre-listing FS. **Assessor's Pro-Tip:** The 3-year audited FS must be signed under Companies Act 2013 Schedule III for Section 8 Companies, or under the state Trust Act for charitable trusts. If the NPO follows a fund-accounting framework (ICAI Technical Guide for NPOs), ensure it is adopted CONSISTENTLY across all 3 years — any change in GAAP mid-period requires restatement.
